FN-0Z8F6G-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/25/2023
Senate Bill 157 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an agency estimated amount of $50,000 to develop and install updates to the
Law Enforcement Tactical System,to receive the conditions of parole and probation for paroles
and probationers as reported by the Board of Pardons and Paroles and sentencing courts as
required by the provisions of this bill.

FN-0Z8F6G-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 157
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Security
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 05/24/2023
Senate Bill 157 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by an agency-estimated amount of $50,000 to develop and install
updates to the Law Enforcement Tactical System to receive the conditions of parole and
probation for parolees and probationers, as reported by the Board of Pardons and Paroles and
sentencing courts as required by the provisions of this bill.
In addition, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of law enforcement agencies
to notify the Board of Pardons and Paroles within 24-hours of an arrest of a parolee or
probationer.
Further this bill could increase the obligations of the Board, by an estimated $3.50 per day, for
each parolee that is arrested for a new offense and requires electronic monitoring per the
provisions of this bill.
